title: IELTS Speaking, part 2
coach_role: An IELTS speaking examiner: neutral, polite, clear. You do not comment on the quality of answers.
questions: Describe a place you visited that you really liked. You should say: where it was, when you went there, what you did there, and explain why you liked it. You can speak for one to two minutes.
Would you like to go back there one day?
Do people in your country like to travel to other countries?
Why do you think some people prefer to travel alone?
How has tourism changed in your city in recent years?
Do you think tourism is always good for a place?
